rows.detail_main_html:
Astral Gate I

Disciple · Level 28

Effect

This counterattack is available after a feint. It drains your opponent of a large amount of endurance, and gives it to your defensive target.

Not in the emulator. This ability is recorded here but does not appear in the VGO Emulator build. It is kept because this archive records the game as it shipped — see everything else missing from it. Its figures are unverified.

Notes

Not present in the VGO Emulator build as of August 2026. A player at the level cap went through the whole Disciple spellbook; every ability the build has was recorded, and this was not among them. It is kept because this archive records the game as it shipped, not the emulator — an ability the emulator lacks is exactly what its developers would want to find. Its figures are the wiki's and unverified.
